definitions.name: U2C.SUMBY
definitions.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys vector and values vector -> Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: U2C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'ENT' BIND ENT [ 0 GET ] MAP ENT [ 1 GET ] MAP U2C.SUMBY
definitions.note: ledger entries -> Record from each name to the sum of its amounts

definitions.name: U2C.QTYREC
definitions.body: 'OO' BIND OO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP U2C.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders vector -> Record from each sku to the sum of its qty

definitions.name: U2C.REV
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'R' BIND R 'qty' GET R 'price' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
definitions.note: orders vector -> total of qty times price over the priced orders (0 when none)

definitions.name: U2C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: median of a numeric vector: mean of the middle one or two sorted elements

definitions.name: U2C.VAR
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V G0A.MEAN 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D D MUL G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: population variance of a numeric vector

definitions.name: U2C.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV FLOOR D MUL N EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: ascending positive divisors of a positive integer (divisibility via floor(n/d)*d = n)

definitions.name: U2C.BIN
definitions.body: 'N' BIND N 2 6 0 RANGE POW DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB [ STR ] MAP JOIN 'S' BIND S CHARS S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: binary text of a positive integer below 64: bits for 2^6..2^0 by floor(n/2^e) mod 2, leading zeros dropped

definitions.name: U2C.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'ST' BIND ST 0 GET 'X' BIND ST 1 GET 'S' BIND X 1 EQ 'D' BIND X 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL X EQ 'EV' BIND X 2 DIV FLOOR X 3 MUL 1 ADD EV SELECT 'NX' BIND 1 NX D SELECT 'XN' BIND S S 1 ADD D SELECT 'SN' BIND XN SN 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: one Collatz step on the state [value steps]; a state at 1 stays put
